svg.title: October 2026 Fed-decision contract readings on Kalshi and Polymarket
svg.desc: At pool access time 13:33 UTC on September 19, 2026, Kalshi displayed 54 percent for a 25-basis-point hike and 45 percent for maintain rate. Polymarket displayed 56 percent for a 25-basis-point increase and 44 percent for no change. Source: direct Kalshi and Polymarket October event pages. These are separate venue-specific contract readings, not a consensus.
svg.text: October decision: named 25 bp-hike rows remain first
Direct event pages accessed September 19, 2026 · 13:33 UTC · source: Kalshi and Polymarket
Since Sep. 18, 19:06 UTC: hike −2 points; maintain +2
Since Sep. 18, 19:06 UTC: hike +1 point; no change unchanged
Read the scope before the percentage
Each bar is a named October-only event-contract row. The visual does not combine venues, derive a distribution, or explain an asset move.
